334ad76e-0588-45c0-9be2-ce6e7987f685/Eve.en: Taiwu, I admire all that you have done...<NL>You have achieved Sky Divider and Earth Splitter, becoming a sage for all ages; this world will let you roam freely...
334ad76e-0588-45c0-9be2-ce6e7987f685/Eve.cn: 太吾，感佩你所做的一切……<NL>你已开天辟地，成万古之圣，此方世界将任你遨游……
334ad76e-0588-45c0-9be2-ce6e7987f685/Eve.ru: Тайу, я восхищаюсь всем, что ты сделал...<NL>Вы достигли Разделения Неба и Земли, став мудрецом на все века; этот мир позволит вам свободно странствовать...

334ad76e-0588-45c0-9be2-ce6e7987f685/Opt.en: Heaven and Earth are vast, all roads ahead are clear...
334ad76e-0588-45c0-9be2-ce6e7987f685/Opt.ru: Небо и Земля необъятны, все дороги впереди чисты...

334ad76e-0588-45c0-9be2-ce6e7987f685/Opt.en: Spring is mild and scenery bright, all creatures thrive...
334ad76e-0588-45c0-9be2-ce6e7987f685/Opt.ru: Весна мягкая, пейзажи яркие, все живые существа процветают...

334ad76e-0588-45c0-9be2-ce6e7987f685/Opt.en: With no burdens in mind, leisurely return to the old home...
334ad76e-0588-45c0-9be2-ce6e7987f685/Opt.ru: Не думая ни о чем, неторопливо возвращайтесь в старый дом...

334ad76e-0588-45c0-9be2-ce6e7987f685/Opt.en: Free in the mortal world, I go to enjoy myself...
334ad76e-0588-45c0-9be2-ce6e7987f685/Opt.ru: Свободный в мире смертных, я иду наслаждаться жизнью...

334ad76e-0588-45c0-9be2-ce6e7987f685/Opt.en: All eight directions unified, I can roam the world freely...
334ad76e-0588-45c0-9be2-ce6e7987f685/Opt.ru: Все восемь направлений объединены, я могу свободно бродить по миру...

98d1ebbc-df39-491f-83a5-5268d14dd25b/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> gazes into Taiwu Village from afar,<NL>seeing wisps of cooking smoke, cheerful laughter, men, women, old and young, all beaming with joy, a scene of harmony.<NL>From now on, the mortal world is free from demon scourges, Heaven and Earth restored to clarity,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s Ambition is fulfilled, and he can't help but smile...
98d1ebbc-df39-491f-83a5-5268d14dd25b/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />远眺太吾村中，<NL>但见炊烟袅袅，笑语盈盈，男女老少，无不喜形于色，一派祥和。<NL>自此人世再无妖魔肆虐，天地复归清朗，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />壮志既酬，不禁莞尔一笑……

a223cabc-fa7e-4f0e-a010-d51c0d883e92/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looks around,<NL>the mountains and rivers are clear, the grass and trees lush, birds chase clouds, beasts return to forests,<NL>the new world is just formed, Heaven and Earth are full of vitality, all things are in their place,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s heart is warm and comfortable, unconsciously filled with infinite hope...
a223cabc-fa7e-4f0e-a010-d51c0d883e92/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />举目四望，<NL>山川澄澈，草木繁茂，飞鸟逐云，走兽归林，<NL>新世界初成，天地间生机盎然，万物各得其所，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心中一片温润熨帖，不觉涌起无限希冀……

ecc33cfa-977d-43cb-b121-2319b5674421/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looks up into the distance,<NL>the young seedlings in the fields are green, the smoke from village houses curls up, all things do not contend or disturb, each is settled in its place,<NL>seeing this peaceful and tranquil scene, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s heart has no more attachments,<NL>then he turns around, strolls leisurely, and heads straight back to Taiwu Village...
ecc33cfa-977d-43cb-b121-2319b5674421/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />仰头望向远方，<NL>田间禾苗青青，村舍炊烟袅袅，万物不争不扰，各安其位，<NL>见此平和恬淡之景，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心中再无挂碍，<NL>随即转身，信步悠悠，径向太吾村中归去……

dd21b16d-2749-4a25-9c8d-c939d6ad685c/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looks around,<NL>seeing children chasing and playing, villagers happily drinking liquor together,<NL>the world is now a peaceful place, every corner a paradise.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> smiles freely, from now on the sky is high and the sea vast, the Martial World is boundless,<NL>he can indulge in the landscapes and enjoy the splendor of the mortal world...
dd21b16d-2749-4a25-9c8d-c939d6ad685c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />放眼四顾，<NL>但见稚子追逐嬉闹，村人把酒言欢，<NL>世间已是一片安宁，处处皆是乐土。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />潇洒一笑，从此天高海阔，江湖浩渺，<NL>自可纵情山水，尽享人间繁华……

3ec6a15b-ac32-4686-9e9d-2817dac57f9f/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> stops and gazes into the distance,<NL>all within the four seas are beneath his feet; inside and outside the universe, he can come and go as he pleases.<NL>This vast world, mountains and rivers peaceful, people safe, nowhere is not saturated with his efforts and achievements,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> sees this scene, smiles proudly, turns around and walks away leisurely...
3ec6a15b-ac32-4686-9e9d-2817dac57f9f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />驻足远眺，<NL>四海之内，皆是足下之地；寰宇内外，自可任意来去。<NL>这偌大天下，山川静好，百姓安然，无处不浸透着自己的心血功业，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />见此景象，傲然一笑，转身信步离去……

04651076-949b-4f8c-a69a-d7db4921027d/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was struck in a vital point by Xiangshu,<NL>and fell into a pool of blood...
04651076-949b-4f8c-a69a-d7db4921027d/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />被相枢击中要害，<NL>倒在了一片血泊之中……
04651076-949b-4f8c-a69a-d7db4921027d/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> был поражен в жизненно важную точку Сяншу,<NL>и упал в лужу крови...

ed2dda0f-fe59-4c46-94b8-038756d60a5d/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s "Fuyu Sword" suddenly lost its light and instantly turned to ashes!<NL>Huanxin lightly nodded to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, smiled slightly, and then dissipated into the wind...<NL><NL>Having lost the last chance to subdue the demon, Xiangshu wreaked havoc in the mortal world without restraint,<NL>there was not a single inch of pure land left in the world,<NL>everyone had become evil ghosts and demons...
ed2dda0f-fe59-4c46-94b8-038756d60a5d/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />手中的「伏虞剑」光芒顿失，瞬间化成了飞灰！<NL>焕心向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />轻轻点头，微微一笑，也随即消散在了狂风之中……<NL><NL>失去了最后一个降伏妖魔的机会，相枢于人间肆无忌惮地施虐，<NL>世间再也没有一寸净土，<NL>无人不是恶鬼妖魔……
